rows.query: Investigate a technical topic with several researchers, reconcile sources, review a draft and deliver a cited report.
把一个技术课题交给研究团队，分头调查、核对来源、审稿，最后交付有引用的报告。
Coordinate specialists to produce system architecture, deployment and security designs with explicit handoffs.
请一个完整专家团队协作，产出系统架构、部署和安全设计，并明确各阶段交接。
Our API slows during bursts. Design a realistic load experiment, identify the bottleneck and validate the optimization.
API在突发流量时变慢，请设计贴近实际的压测，定位瓶颈并验证优化前后效果。
Turn business requirements into a structured test design covering boundaries, exceptions and traceability.
把业务需求转为结构化测试设计，覆盖边界、异常，并能追溯到原需求。
Deliver a coding feature through focused parallel implementers, test-first steps, separate specification and quality reviews, and final integration.
把编码功能交给多个独立执行者并行实现，先建失败测试，分别做规格与质量评审，再集成验收。
Polish and translate a machine learning paper into English while preserving equations and citations.
把机器学习论文翻译润色成英文，保留公式与引用，检查术语表达。
Verify the login flow of a local web app in a browser and capture screenshots and console errors.
在浏览器里验证本地网页应用的登录流程，保留截图和控制台报错。
Extract text and tabular data from a PDF and combine its pages into a new document.
从PDF提取文字和表格，再把指定页面合并成一份新文档。
Create an Excel workbook with editable formulas, consistent formatting and recalculated results.
制作Excel工作簿，保留可编辑公式、统一格式并重新计算结果。
Check whether a travel itinerary is affordable using transportation, accommodation and meal costs, and suggest cost-saving alternatives.
按交通、住宿和餐饮费用核算旅行行程预算，判断是否超支并给出省钱替代方案。
Find current documentation and code examples for a specific version of a programming library.
查询某个编程库指定版本的最新文档与代码示例，避免旧版接口。
Use GitHub to inspect a repository's issues and pull requests through its service connector.
通过服务连接器查看GitHub仓库的issue和pull request。
Search my Notion workspace pages and fetch the relevant page content through its connector.
通过连接器搜索我的Notion工作区页面，并读取相关页面内容。
Find an HR service connector for employee social insurance and benefits administration.
寻找可以处理员工社保、公积金等人事业务的服务连接器。
Clean clinical trial records and standardize them to SDTM for regulatory submission, handling missing and abnormal laboratory values.
清理临床试验记录，处理缺失值和异常检验数据，并整理成监管申报需要的SDTM数据。
Two branches generated conflicting Drizzle Kit migration snapshots and journals. Repair the merge and validate the database migration.
两个分支生成的Drizzle Kit数据库迁移快照和日志发生冲突，请修复合并并验证迁移。
Organize a folder of scattered invoices and receipts for tax preparation, extract key fields and sort consistently.
为报税整理散乱的发票收据，提取关键信息并按一致规则分类命名。
Reduce the size of our Docker image with a secure multi-stage build and check the production Compose configuration.
用安全的Docker多阶段构建缩小镜像，并检查生产环境Compose配置。
Clean missing values, outliers and mixed formats in a scraped dataset, then produce charts showing its main patterns.
清洗爬取数据中的缺失值、异常和混合格式，再生成展示主要规律的可视化图表。
Remove unreliable columns from a multiple sequence alignment with ClipKIT or trimAl before phylogenetic analysis.
在系统发育分析之前，使用ClipKIT或trimAl去掉多序列比对中不可靠的列。
Several Kubernetes workers start together and PostgreSQL deadlocks during CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS. Diagnose concurrent schema initialization.
多个Kubernetes worker同时启动，在PostgreSQL执行CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS时死锁，请定位并发建表初始化问题。
Change a shared HTTP response schema consumed by multiple services and update the producers and consumers with explicit failure semantics.
修改多个服务消费的共享HTTP响应结构，协调生产者和消费者，并明确失败语义和端到端证据。
Yesterday's working behavior now fails after a code change. Establish a failing regression test before the smallest repair.
昨天正常的功能在一次代码改动后坏了，请先建立失败的回归测试，再做最小修复并核验。
Detect nucleotide-resolution crosslink sites from eCLIP truncation data, then annotate the sites to RNA features.
根据eCLIP截断数据识别单核苷酸分辨率的交联位点，并把位点注释到RNA功能区域。
Extract tokens and variables from a Figma file and use them to define project-specific design system rules.
从Figma设计文件提取token和变量，用来定义项目自己的设计系统规则。
A request succeeds at the API but disappears before the actual consumer. Trace each information-flow boundary to locate the first divergence.
请求在API端显示成功，但真实消费者没收到，请沿信息流逐层检查，找出第一个偏离预期的边界。

checks.macInstaller: passed, including byte-identical global relation registry, cross-workspace, idempotence and rollback
checks.securityBaseline: passed, including credential-shaped positive fixtures and Skill-name negative fixtures

originalWorkspaceQualityGates.failure: document-integrity: 56 externally deleted tracked versions files; preserved and excluded from this delivery

checks.deliverySnapshotDocuments: passed: 336 tracked text files; HEAD historical files retained only in independent delivery-check copy

taskTree.flow: not applicable: no execution flow script
taskTree.shellCompact: passed with TASK_TREE_KIT_DIR pointing to installed global kit
taskTree.initialShellFailure: configured sibling toolkit absent next to this worktree; original stderr retained in final-compact.log

limitations: Full-node candidate generation is not all-pairs enumeration; 11314 nodes have no supported relationship under the current candidate budget and remain searchable.
All model judging stages use configured gpt-6.1-terra; agreement and citation calibration are not independent human ground truth.

The original temporary first/second-pass batch cache was lost when /tmp was cleaned. The surviving full two-pass registry was re-audited for every retained citation and source fingerprints were rebound before deployment; original two-pass batch receipts are unavailable.

52 diagnostic queries are a small, non-pristine benchmark. Assisted hit includes conditional hints and is not business-task success; main ranking changed in some cases although binary primary hits did not regress.
100 overlapping socket requests are served by four query processes, not 100 simultaneous CPU computations. Hook timings include per-request process and context costs.
194 lacks four Mac-only node_repl tools; no Linux placeholders were introduced.
IDE tests verify actual discovery and exact global content reading; they do not execute every expert, Skill workflow, or remote MCP API.
Autostart service state was inspected but no complete machine reboot was performed.
No physical-footprint or peak-memory conclusion is supported by these runs.
Original workspace quality check was 14/15 because unrelated tracked history files are deleted; the independent delivery snapshot retains HEAD history and passes document checks.

recovery.name: compact
recovery.method: same checker with supported TASK_TREE_KIT_DIR override
